description: Watch a single page, a list of URLs, or a whole website section on a schedule. Supports natural-language `watch_for` focus, explicit `condition` rules (e.g. `price < 50`, `content contains "In Stock"`, `added_urls_count > 0`), and email or webhook notifications.

action.description: Action to perform (defaults to 'create' when url/urls given, else 'list')

condition.description: Optional trigger rule expression, e.g. 'price < 50', 'content contains "In Stock"', 'added_urls_count > 0'

id.description: Monitor ID (required for get, check, pause, resume, delete)

max_pages.description: Max pages to sample when mode is 'site' (default 5)

mode.description: Watch scope: page (default), urls, or site

notify_email.description: Email address to notify when triggered, or 'true' to use the account email

url.description: Page or site URL to watch

urls.description: Multiple URLs to watch when mode is 'urls'

watch_for.description: What to watch for, e.g. 'Pricing tiers and discounts'

webhook_url.description: HTTPS webhook URL to POST when triggered

name: web_monitor
title: Monitor web pages or sites
